
Various gamma distributions are shown in the visualisation below, for different values of\ $\alpha$ and\ $\beta$.


```{r, BetaDemo, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Beta distributions."}
# --- Parameters ---
ms <- c(0.5, 1.5, 2)   # m parameter
ns <- c(0.5, 1.8)      # n parameter

x <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 600)

# Compute y-range
yrange <- c(0, max(sapply(ms, function(m) sapply(ns, function(n) dbeta((m-1)/(m+n-2), shape1 = m, shape2 = n))))*1.1)
xrange <- c(0, 1)

# --- Create figure ---
fig <- plot_ly(width = 700, height = 450)

# Add all traces
counter <- 1
for(m in ms){
  for(n in ns){
    fig <- fig %>% add_lines(
      x = x,
      y = dbeta(x, shape1 = m, shape2 = n),
      visible = FALSE,
      line = list(color = "darkgreen", width = 2.5),
      name = paste0("m=", m, ", n=", n),
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

# --- Set default visible trace (first m/n) ---
for(i in seq_along(fig$x$data)){
  trace <- fig$x$data[[i]]
  if(trace$name == paste0("m=", ms[1], ", n=", ns[1])){
    fig$x$data[[i]]$visible <- TRUE
  } else {
    fig$x$data[[i]]$visible <- FALSE
  }
}

# --- Create buttons with dynamic mean/variance annotation ---
buttons <- list()
counter <- 1
for(m in ms){
  for(n in ns){
    vis <- rep(FALSE, length(ms)*length(ns))
    vis[counter] <- TRUE
    
    mean_val <- m / (m+n)
    var_val  <- (m*n)/((m+n)^2 * (m+n+1))
    
    buttons[[counter]] <- list(
      method = "update",
      args = list(
        list(visible = vis),
        list(
          title = paste0("Beta PDF: m=", m, ", n=", n),
          xaxis = list(range = xrange),
          yaxis = list(range = yrange),
          annotations = list(
            list(
              x = 0.95, y = 0.95,
              xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
              text = paste0("mean=", round(mean_val,2), "<br>var=", round(var_val,2)),
              showarrow = FALSE,
              xanchor = "right", yanchor = "top",
              font = list(size = 12, color = "black")
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      label = paste0("m=", m, ", n=", n)
    )
    
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

# --- Arrange buttons in 2 rows (n=1 top, n=2 bottom) ---
top_row_buttons <- buttons[seq(1, length(buttons), 2)]
bottom_row_buttons <- buttons[seq(2, length(buttons), 2)]

# --- Layout ---
fig <- fig %>% layout(
  title = list(text = "Beta distribution", x = 0.5),
  xaxis = list(title = "x", range = xrange),
  yaxis = list(title = "Density", range = yrange),
  updatemenus = list(
    list(
      type = "buttons",
      direction = "right",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.2,
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      buttons = top_row_buttons
    ),
    list(
      type = "buttons",
      direction = "right",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.3,
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      buttons = bottom_row_buttons
    )
  )
)

# --- Display ---
fig
```
